component.name: FlightDeck
component.summary: Smart Meeting Reminders & Flight Deck HUD

description.p: FlightDeck is a cross-platform desktop application that provides smart meeting reminders, flight deck timeline agendas, and multi-modal transit leave-time alerts with customizable mascot pilots.

ul.li: Today-only calendar sync with zero-latency caching
Multi-stage notification banners with mascot aviators
Smart departure ETA calculations for public transit, driving, cycling, and walking
Clean Catppuccin Mocha aesthetic with full Wayland and X11 support

description.p: Release 1.0.5: Repository hygiene, packaging isolation, and Flatpak support.
